user.description:
Connect a HIQ controller through the CybroScgiServer.
The scgi server must be running before you continue. See the [documentation](https://github.com/killer0071234/ha-hiq#prerequisites).

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the scgi server. For the CybroScgiServer add-on use 85493909-cybroscgiserver.
data_description.port: Port of the scgi server. For the CybroScgiServer add-on use 4000.
data_description.address: Network address (NAD) of the HIQ controller, e.g. 1000.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the scgi server. Check that it is running and that host and port are correct.
error.plc_not_existing: The scgi server knows no HIQ controller with this address. Check the NAD and that the controller is online.
error.select_option_invalid: Enter each option as label=value with a whole number as value, e.g. eco=1.
error.select_option_duplicate_label: Each option label may only be used once.
error.select_option_duplicate_value: Each option value may only be used once.

abort.already_configured: This HIQ controller is already configured.

init.title: HIQ options
init.description: Custom entities show or set any variable of the controller.

add_entity.title: Add custom entity
add_entity.description:
Choose the type of entity.
- Sensor: shows the value of a variable.
- Select: writes one of several values to a variable.

add_sensor.title: Add custom sensor
add_sensor.description: Add a sensor that shows the value of a controller variable.

data_description.name: Name of the sensor in Home Assistant.
data_description.tag: Variable to read, e.g. cybro_serial. The list shows all variables of this controller.
data_description.value_template: Optional template to convert the raw value, which is available as value. See the documentation for examples.
data_description.device_class: Type of the sensor. Sets the icon and the units that fit.
data_description.state_class: Needed for long-term statistics: Measurement for values like a temperature, Total or Total increasing for counters.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Unit of the value. Choose one from the list or enter your own. It must fit the device class.

add_select.title: Add custom select
add_select.description: Add a select that writes one of several values to a controller variable. It shows the option of the current value.

data_description.name: Name of the select in Home Assistant.
data_description.tag: Variable to read and write, e.g. th00_mode. The list shows all variables of this controller.
data_description.options: One option per entry as label=value. The value is a whole number and is written to the variable, e.g. eco=1.

edit_sensor.title: Edit custom sensor
edit_sensor.description: Change the settings of the custom sensor. The variable cannot be changed.

data_description.name: Name of the sensor in Home Assistant.
data_description.value_template: Optional template to convert the raw value, which is available as value. See the documentation for examples.
data_description.device_class: Type of the sensor. Sets the icon and the units that fit.
data_description.state_class: Needed for long-term statistics: Measurement for values like a temperature, Total or Total increasing for counters.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Unit of the value. Choose one from the list or enter your own. It must fit the device class.

edit_select.title: Edit custom select
edit_select.description: Change the name and the options of the custom select. The variable cannot be changed.

data_description.name: Name of the select in Home Assistant.
data_description.options: One option per entry as label=value. The value is a whole number and is written to the variable, e.g. eco=1.

select_edit_entity.title: Edit custom entity
select_edit_entity.description: Choose the custom entity to edit.

data_description.index: Custom sensor or select of this controller.

remove_entity.title: Remove custom entities
remove_entity.description: Choose the custom entities to remove. They are also deleted from Home Assistant.

data_description.index: Custom sensors and selects of this controller.

error.select_option_invalid: Enter each option as label=value with a whole number as value, e.g. eco=1.
error.select_option_duplicate_label: Each option label may only be used once.
error.select_option_duplicate_value: Each option value may only be used once.

alarm_event.name: Alarm clock event
alarm_event.description: Sends the smartphone alarm clock event (alarm clock rings) to the HIQ controller.

presence_signal.name: Presence signal
presence_signal.description: Sends the smartphone presence signal to the HIQ controller.

charge_on_event.name: Charge on event
charge_on_event.description: Sends the smartphone charge on event (charger connected) to the HIQ controller.

charge_off_event.name: Charge off event
charge_off_event.description: Sends the smartphone charge off event (charger disconnected) to the HIQ controller.

home_event.name: Home event
home_event.description: Sends the smartphone home event to the HIQ controller.

precede_event.name: Precede event
precede_event.description: Sends the smartphone event triggered some minutes before the alarm clock to the HIQ controller, e.g. to turn on the heating in advance.

time.name: Precede time
time.description: Minutes before the alarm clock at which the event is triggered.

write_tag.name: Write tag
write_tag.description: Writes a value to a variable of the HIQ controller.

tag.name: Variable
tag.description: Name of the controller variable without the cNAD. prefix, e.g. smartphone_presence_signal.

value.name: Value
value.description: Value to write, e.g. 10. Negative and decimal values are allowed.
